definitions.gloss: older work; previous work; back catalog title
definitions.explanation: A creative work (film, book, album, game, etc.) from an earlier period, as opposed to a new release. Commonly used in entertainment and media contexts to refer to titles no longer considered current.

examples.japanese: {旧作|きゅうさく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧DVD⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{借|か}りた→借りる：00532_kariru⟧。
examples.english: I rented a DVD of an older title.

examples.japanese: ⟦レンタル→レンタル：11194_rentaru⟧⟦ショップ→ショップ：08913_shoppu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{旧作|きゅうさく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ほう⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧。
examples.english: At the rental shop, older titles are cheaper.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{旧作|きゅうさく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{全部|ぜんぶ}→全部：02888_zenbu⟧⟦{読|よ}んで→読む：00426_yomu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{新作|しんさく}→新作：09523_shinsaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{取|と}りかかった。
examples.english: I read all of his previous works before starting on the new one.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{監督|かんとく}→監督：00185_kantoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{旧作|きゅうさく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{高|たか}く→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦{評価|ひょうか}→評価：03583_hyouka⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This director's older works are still highly regarded.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{旧|きゅう}→旧：19346_kyuu⟧ (old, former) and ⟦{作|さく}→作：27430_saku⟧ (work, production). The direct antonym is ⟦{新作|しんさく}→新作：09523_shinsaku⟧ (new work/release), and the two are frequently contrasted.

The word is neutral in tone — it simply indicates that a work is not new, without implying that it is outdated or inferior. In fact, {旧作|きゅうさく} is often used when recommending older titles that are worth revisiting.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {旧作|きゅうさく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{観|み}る→観る：22793_miru⟧: to watch an older film
- {旧作|きゅうさく}⟦レンタル→レンタル：11194_rentaru⟧: rental of older titles
- {旧作|きゅうさく}⟦セール→セール：07780_seeru⟧: sale on back catalog titles
- {旧作|きゅうさく}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{名作|めいさく}→名作：11869_meisaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧: many older works are masterpieces too

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{新作|しんさく}→新作：09523_shinsaku⟧: new work, new release — the direct opposite
- ⟦{前作|ぜんさく}→前作：30236_zensaku⟧: previous work — specifically the one immediately before the current one, not older works in general
- ⟦{名作|めいさく}→名作：11869_meisaku⟧: masterpiece — a quality judgment rather than a time-based classification
